<assessment>SOURCE is one street-level oblique showing the tower’s front and right elevations, its descending stepped wing and connected low left block. Visible features include a pale projecting grid, recessed glazing and opaque infill, scattered recessed outdoor bays, planted terraces, flat roof edges, a darker lower facade zone and glazed street frontage. CURRENT 10–11 reproduce these broad relationships, but only L16 has the corrected six-front/five-side bay division; surrounding rows retain five/four divisions. Low-wing terraces still read as stacked projecting shelves rather than the source’s integrated outdoor pockets. Rear elevations and concealed joints cannot be verified against this source; no definite slab penetration or floating railing is established. Context removal follows recorded user intent; the conflicting older neighbor-retention requirement remains unresolved and does not justify restoration.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: CURRENT 11 shows L16 corrected to six front/five right-side bays, while adjacent rows remain five/four. This produces inconsistent vertical divisions and leaves source-visible opening and infill positions unresolved.
action: Preserve L16’s corrected bay count. Locally correct the remaining source-visible rows to the corresponding six/five divisions, aligning columns, glazing, opaque panels and recessed openings across floors. Retain completed recess components where compatible; preserve existing floor elevations.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="oblique">problem: CURRENT 9–10 show the low-wing terraces predominantly as continuous glass-edged shelves with backing walls. SOURCE shows staggered outdoor pockets integrated into the stepped enclosure.
action: Locally adjust the visible terrace enclosures and recesses to match those pockets, connecting floors, side returns and perimeter edges. Preserve matching planting and terrace edges; verify slab-to-wall clearances without assuming hidden intersections.</issue>
<keep>L16 representative row’s six-front/five-right-side bay count.
Completed recessed glazing and side-return relief where compatible with corrected divisions.
</keep>
